newsitem.title: USA: Phillips gets stake in China methane venture.
newsitem.headline: Phillips gets stake in China methane venture.

text.p: Phillips China Inc, a unit of Phillips Petroleum Co, said Thursday it took a majority stake in the Hedong joint venture coalbed methane concession in Shanxi Province, China.
Through an agreement with CBM Energy Associates LC, Phillips it will operate the project, which will allow it to explore for and produce hydrocarbons onshore China.
The Hedong concession covers 781,000 acres and is about 120 miles west of Taiyuan, in the eastern Ordos Basin.
Phillips said it will be assigned a 65 percent interest in the venture. Chinese partners own a 30 percent interest, and CBM retains a five percent interest
Seismic and drilling operations will begin early in 1997, the company said.
